category_title: Children with ASD requiring high structure and emotional regulation support
scenario_title: Handling peer disagreement during philosophical dialogue
minimal_context: Bruce is participating in a structured group philosophical dialogue about the 'Laura and Paul' story.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are going to start our group discussion about the 'Laura and Paul' story. Remember to raise your hand if you want to speak.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Raises hand) I want to talk about the story. I think Paul should have told the truth.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Thank you for sharing. Another student just said they disagree with your point. What do you think about that?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks visibly frustrated) Why did they say that? They shouldn't say that.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: People can have different thoughts in the group. Let's just keep going with the discussion.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am angry because the other children are disagreeing with me! I am not staying here.
